quotes.text: AI Data Centers are expanding rapidly and using more energy and water than entire cities. That energy demand is driving up utility costs for consumers. [...] My legislation ensures we take a hard look at how this growth impacts rural communities that are powering the AI industry, and make sure families aren’t left paying the price. But at the same time, it’s important that rural communities are not left behind in the new opportunities that AI data centers will provide for agricultural sciences and an improved ability to compete in this modern era.

I think the first and foremost effort is to realize that there are real concerns that Congress needs to address. We need to put some firewalls to protect against the impacts on energy, electricity costs and the use of water, and that’s why I am supporting legislation at the federal level that will slow this process down.
